_comment: Copy this to web/config.json on a hosted deployment, and fill it in from
what `cdk deploy` printed. Without this file the viewer calls relative URLs
(api/health, api/design) and expects its own Python server -- which is what
happens on a laptop and in Colab, and is why that path needs no config at all.
Nothing here is a secret. A Cognito user pool client id is a public
identifier; the client is created without a secret precisely because a
static page cannot keep one. Do not ever put a key, a token or an AWS
credential in this file -- anyone who loads the page can read it.
